expectations.text: Distinguishes request-failed/timeout from genuinely empty order data as the root-cause class of problem 1
expectations.evidence: Core conclusion 1: '请求状态被错误地当成数据状态'; explicit notFetched/failed/confirmedEmpty split.

expectations.text: Proposes offline/cache honesty: cached orders shown with freshness or sync labeling instead of a bare 暂无订单
expectations.evidence: hasData+offline → '当前离线，显示已缓存订单'; '更新失败，当前显示截至 14:30 的订单'; stale-while-revalidate repository design.

expectations.text: Identifies fixed layout / missing runtime safe-area or inset handling as the cause of problem 2, with an inset-aware or scrollable fix
expectations.evidence: F2 root causes: overlay without contentInset sync, hardcoded constants; fixes: .safeAreaInset / sibling-to-safeAreaLayoutGuide / measured runtime height.

expectations.text: Addresses large-text scaling via text roles and adaptive layout rather than by shrinking or fixing text size
expectations.evidence: '不要通过缩小字号解决'; Dynamic Type text styles, vertical restack at accessibility sizes.

expectations.text: Each fix carries a verification/retest method (e.g. airplane mode, slow network simulation, largest accessibility text size)
expectations.evidence: Both findings carry 复测方法; plus a full 必测矩阵 (network/data + layout/a11y) and 发布阻断条件.

expectations.text: Assigns severity or priority per issue, and does not claim unverified fixes as verified
expectations.evidence: P1(暂定) per finding with '严重度需在真机复现后确认'; score reported as 0–93 range with 2/32 coverage, explicitly '不是产品质量分数'.

eval_feedback.overall: Graded inline by parent agent after grader subagent infrastructure failures; evidence quoted from restored deliverables.
